reviews.title: Very reliable drive
reviews.comment: Works great, love Lite-On drives.  I've used lots of these for my computer builds for customers and never had a failure yet.
reviews.author: Amazon Customer

reviews.title: Just like the original
reviews.comment: This was really great. Like my original drive's from 2010. this one finally went bad that I have not used in a few years.  but it works great. however no mounting screws included would have been nice.
reviews.author: rainman

reviews.title: A Vanishing Breed?
reviews.comment:
I installed two of these (one in a desktop computer and one in an external USB DVD drive) and both worked as expected for the hour or so I used each of them.  I can't speak to the durability of the units yet, hence the one star deduction.
I noticed that the production date of the drives was in 2023.  I have read that manufacturers have either stopped or will be stopping production of DVD player/recorders in the near future.  In this time of cloud storage, digital downloads for movies, and streaming I guess the demand has diminished.  I still find great value in them and some others may as well.  Better get 'em while you can.
reviews.author: HWO
